scope: Theorem 5.12 (Transfer from signed correlations to the full spin field) of the manuscript “BKT universality for height and planar spin fields” (preprints/BKT-universality-for-height-and-planar-spin-fields-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e6a8df09e021c4a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 80. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix one of the ordinary nearest-neighbor XY or Villain models on Dn, at a fixed positive inverse temperature, with zero boundary angles. Suppose there are constants K > 1/(4π) and A > 0, independent of n, with the following properties. Put an(x) = A exp{Gn(x, x)/(2K)}, Uσ n (x) = an(x)eiσθx , Sσ n(f) = n−2 X x∈D◦ n f(x)Uσ n (x). (i) For every m ≥ 1, every signs σi ∈ {−1, 1}, every E ⋐ D, and every δ > 0, uniformly for xi ∈ E ∩ D◦ n with |xi − xj| ≥ δ for i ̸= j, E m Y i=1 Uσi n (xi) − exp    − 1 K X i<j σiσjGD(xi, xj)    −→ 0. (5.36) (ii) There is Q ∈ [0, 2) such that, for every E ⋐ D, some CE < ∞ satisfies 0 ≤ E[Uσ n (x)Uτ n (y)] ≤ CE(|x − y| + n−1 )−Q (5.37) for all n, all x, y ∈ E ∩ D◦ n, including x = y, and all σ, τ ∈ {−1, 1}. Then S+ n =⇒ VK,D in H−3 loc (D) along the full sequence of integers n. All finite collections of complex smeared fields converge jointly, and every mixed moment of such a collection converges to (5.32).
